messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick coordination thread for onsite candidate (Liam Chen) next Friday. Interview window 10:00am-3:00pm (hybrid). He needs early access around 08:30am to collect visa paperwork and drop off docs. Also requested: Windows test machine (RTX-class), USB-C dock, ergonomic keyboard, height-adjustable chair, and halal lunch + parking validation. Tagging ops: @Devon_R @IT Support @Facilities.
Devon R.: Got it. For badge creation I need full legal name + DOB. Also confirm if candidate prefers reimbursement or company-arranged taxi.
Aisha Khan: Full name: Liam Chen. DOB: 1994-06-12. He asked to expense taxi if we don't arrange. Please note visa pickup appointment at 09:15.
IT Support: We can image a loaner Windows laptop with an RTX GPU and the dock. We'll preload Win11, VS Code, Docker, and SSH keys config. Anything else?
Aisha Khan: No extra licensed software. Please label the device "candidate-1965" and leave it in room B5.
IT Support: Will do. ETA to B5: 08:05. Image prep tonight.
Facilities: Reserving B5 and will set up adjustable desk + ergonomic chair. Parking spot P2 reserved under "Candidate - Liam Chen". Security escort can badge him at 08:30. Who will meet him in lobby?
Aisha Khan: I'll meet him and add my cell to the calendar invite.
Devon R.: Reimbursement policy: up to $120 for candidate ground travel. Ask Liam to keep receipts. I'll process once submitted.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: candidate meal cap is $40/person. Tag receipts with "candidate-meal" for auto-routing.
Aisha Khan: For catering, proposing halal boxed lunches from Salaam Kitchen (chicken + veg). Any allergy notes?
Devon R.: Please include nut-free labeled option.
Facilities: Catering ordered: halal chicken, halal veg, and nut-free options. Delivery scheduled for 11:45 to B5.
Aisha Khan: Remote panelist Marta will join at 1:00pm PT. AV/IT: please confirm Teams link and mic/cam test 15 minutes prior. Her internal email: marta@redwood.com.
IT Support: Teams meeting created and link added to invites. AV tech to test room A/V at 12:45.
Facilities: Temporary door code for B5: 4721 (expires end of day). Security will also escort if needed.
Aisha Khan: Can the laptop be left unlocked and labeled for the interviewer to begin test quickly?
IT Support: Laptop will be labeled and set with placeholder password "RedwoodGuest123". Please change if candidate requests privacy.
Devon R.: I'll follow up with Liam about receipts and taxi. Parking fees covered if he pays and submits receipt.
Aisha Khan: Also request a small welcome packet with visitor wifi creds and campus map.
Facilities: Welcome packet will be on the desk. Visitor wifi: RedwoodGuest / welcome2025.
People Ops Bot: Calendar invites sent. Reminders scheduled at 24h and 1h before start.
Aisha Khan: Thank you all. I'll post a final pre-onboard checklist here 24h before and DM any last-minute changes. :thumbsup:
Devon R.: Confirmed from finance side.
IT Support: Imaging finished; laptop placed in B5 at 08:05.
Facilities: Catering and parking confirmed.
Aisha Khan: Closing thread 18h before event I'll run through the checklist again.
